ablations.conclusion: each independent economic scenario remained negative; removing either scenario did not reveal a profitable structural core

primary_failure_causes: the continuation terminal condition reused high absorption, low efficiency and non-positive flow acceleration, which contradicts renewed informed price discovery
the OI materiality boundary compared a rolling positive one-minute OI-step median with a fifteen-minute OI change, mixing horizons
the reversal treated same-bar displayed-depth replenishment as reactive absorption even though visible replenishment can be anticipatory or already resting
exact-pool reclaim plus one completed alignment bar did not prove that attack-side inventory had failed before entry
tight structural invalidations combined with 15 bps round-trip expected costs left insufficient post-fill excursion

largest_performance_drivers.negative: both absorbed-flow reversals stopped; together they produced the largest loss contribution
largest_performance_drivers.partially_valid: one informed-flow continuation moved in the intended direction but funding flatten and costs left only a small gain
largest_performance_drivers.frequency: six compiled signals and four executed trades were more active than late V31, but activity came from weakly resolved states rather than repeatable alpha

useful_parts_to_preserve: mutually exclusive classification of efficient inventory creation versus low-impact absorption
causal confirmed external pools and first-penetration semantics
exact-boundary reclaim rather than generic candle reversal
raw exchange OI, futures-index basis and completed executed-flow alignment
NautilusTrader-only orders, fills, costs, positions and NAV
next_design_implications: measure post-attack response over later completed bars rather than same-bar depth changes
use OI boundaries with the same horizon as the state transition
for continuation, require renewed efficient impact rather than absorption
for reversal, require observable failure of attack-side inventory after the pool take before reclaim entry
preserve the scenario-selected causal target through execution instead of replacing it with an arbitrary R cap
